sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar [GM2-07] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar.
Our order history for this part shows 5.17 EUR (po:4500013023-10) against 5.45 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014455-10).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered until March 2027.
Our volume forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Today you supply 80 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 24-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We commit to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month volume and are pleased to incorporate the AS-14404 index clause into our proposal.
This revised offer reflects your verified order history and the positive volume forecast.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.47 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We appreciate your flexibility regarding payment terms and have adjusted our proposal to 30 days net.
In exchange for this faster payment and your improved bid, we are pleased to reduce our price to €5.35 per unit.
This offer reflects a fair compromise that honors your 24-month volume commitment.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.35 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
